tvShow.name: Stormester
tvShow.overview: Danish version of the British “Taskmaster” panel show in which comedians, actors and musicians (the contestants) must solve weird challenges in weird ways.

episodes.name: Christmas Special (2019)
episodes.overview: In this Christmas special, contestants Sofie Linde, Melvin Kakooza, Thomas Warberg, Stephania Potalivo and Jacob Taarnhøj compete for the Taskmaster’s head in marzipan. Along the way, they must make a Christmas song about something un-Christmas-y, pass Santa through a small gap, find a clementine in a Christmas stocking, assist a red cabbage bobsleigh team, and conceal almonds in their mouth or hand.

episodes.name: Christmas Special (2020)
episodes.overview: In this Christmas special, Heino Hansen, Jesper Groth, Lise Baastrup, Sarah Grünewald, and Victor Lander compete for the Taskmaster's head in chocolate. Along the way, they must make a Christmas tree stand, say 'Merry Christmas' as many times as possible, make the longest piece of confectionery, eat as much confectionery as possible, transfer some rice to a pan, make a Santa beard out of something unexpected, and stack plates and bowls on their head.

episodes.name: Christmas Special (2021)
episodes.overview: In this Christmas special, Annika Aakjær, Anders Breinholt, Mahamad Habane, Neel Rønholt and Jakob Thrane compete for the Taskmaster's head in marshmallow. Along the way, they must complete a surprise memory test, make the best snowman, herd some Santa Claus balls, melt a candle clock, and decorate the prettiest Christmas tree hat.

episodes.name: Christmas Special (2022) - An Amazing Christmas Programme
episodes.overview: This single episode Christmas special, featuring the cast of season 6, aired on the 25th of December 2022. In this episode, the contestants must find an almond, predict what another contestant will do with an item, give the Taskmaster a surprising Christmas gift, make their own Christmas wish come true, and try to end up with the lit Christmas tree.

episodes.name: Christmas Special (2023) - A Daring Christmas
episodes.overview: A single-episode Christmas special of Stormester aired on the 25th of December 2023, featuring the contestants from season 7 of the show: Anders Lund Madsen, Hadi Ka-koush, Jesper Ole Feit Andersen, Kathrine Abrahamsen, and Petra Nagel. The contestants must do the right Christmas thing, daringly put an Easter egg in an eggcup, find all 10 ducks hidden in the lab, make the best Santa Claus using a photocopier, and play their Christmas sounds right.

episodes.name: Christmas Special (2024) - Crispy Christmas
episodes.overview: This Christmas Special aired on the 25th of December 2024, and featured the cast of season 8 (Carsten Eskelund, Mathias Helt, Natasha Brock, Puk Elgaard, and Tobias Dybvad).

episodes.name: Stormester X Knæk Cancer
episodes.overview: On the 31st of October 2021, a short Stormester special was broadcast in two parts, during the Knæk Cancer Live telethon, to raise money for the fight against cancer. Knæk Cancer (‘Break Cancer’) is an annual week of television broadcast in Denmark on TV2, usually in October, which culminates in a live charity telethon. Knæk Cancer’s flower logo (or ‘Knæk Cancer-blomst’) is an iconic emblem, and easily recognised by all Danes. The special featured just three contestants, who had to create the second-biggest Knæk Cancer flower, and a portrait of one of their fellow contestants using items no-one else has used. The studio segments of this special were filmed at The Glass Hall in the Tivoli Gardens amusement park.

episodes.name: New Year's Special (2024)
episodes.overview: A single-episode New Year's Special of Stormester aired on the 3rd of January 2025, featuring Clement Kjersgaard, Ditte Hansen, Fredrik Trudslev, Liam O'Connor, Rosa Kildahl.

episodes.name: Christmas Special (2025)
episodes.overview: Christmas Special 2025 was the first two-part holiday season special of Stormester and aired on TV2 between 25 December 2025 and 1 January 2026. The special featured the Season 9 contestants Ane Høgsberg, David Minerba, Lars Hjortshøj, Mette Søndergaard, and Mikkel Klint Thorius, and was won by Ane Høgsberg.

episodes.name: Champions of Champions 01 - The Winners are Back
episodes.overview: The winners from the first five seasons are back to compete for the “Champions of Champions” title. Lasse Rimmer and Mark Le Fêvre kick off the competition.The winners from the first five seasons are back to compete for the “Winner of Winners” title. Lasse Rimmer and Mark Le Fêvre kick off the competition.

episodes.name: Champions of Champions 02 - What Does the Crow Say?
episodes.overview: The competition heats up, and the five winners are challenged by a highly flammable test. Jonas Mogensen is also challenged in an encounter with the house’s garden hose.

episodes.name: Champion of Champions 03 - Exciting Collections
episodes.overview: How do you arrange an angel, a tomato, a clog, a lizard, and a women’s magazine in the right order? The questions pile up right before the finale.

episodes.name: Champion of Champions 04 - The Grand Finale
episodes.overview: We get through onion towers, soap operas, and doomed assistants before crowning the show’s ultimate winner — who also runs off with all the trophies.

episodes.name: One More Chance 01 - The Losers are Back!
episodes.overview: How long does it take five former losers to put a bead in a glass, and who can make the best declaration of love to Taskmaster Lasse Rimmer?

episodes.name: One More Chance 02 - The Liver Pâté Portrait
episodes.overview: What’s the coolest way to spread a slice of rye bread, and which greeting is the most impressive? If you’ve always wondered too, tune in.

episodes.name: One More Chance 03 - Proboscis Monkey
episodes.overview: Irreplaceable destruction, cheering up an old man, egg roulette, and no fewer than 50 tasks in one. You couldn’t ask for more.

episodes.name: One More Chance 04 - Asparagus
episodes.overview: It’s finally decided which contestant can call themselves the best of the worst — and thereby secure bragging rights over the four remaining players.

episodes.name: The very first section
episodes.overview: The first episode - introducing the show rules and contestants

episodes.name: What is a worm?
episodes.overview: Look forward to seeing Lina Rafn's inhuman endurance on a treadmill, the result of an unusual blind drawing, and what a perfect solution Julie and Christian think they have when they are tasked with raising an egg as high above the ground as possible. They all fight for this week's personal prize, but in the end only one question remains: Does Ruben Søltoft ever find out what a slug is?

episodes.name: The Russian lady
episodes.overview: Among other things, we will learn more about how to make an entire block of ice disappear most easily, and whether Google Translate or Morse codes are best when talking to a Russian. Nikolaj Stokholm also feels the consequence of swearing at baked goods, and then the best gift for the grandmaster must be found.

episodes.name: Caesar!
episodes.overview: It does not go quietly when the celebrities this time, among other things, have to draw a horse... on horseback.

episodes.name: Julie you are disqualified
episodes.overview: Now the five experimental mice have to solve four curly tasks, but who builds the tallest potato-bearing tower? And can you play basketball without hands? Christian, Lina, Julie, Nikolaj and Ruben must also make a good investment before we find out who can surprise Mark Le Fêvre in the most creative way - and both boyfriends, clowns and a real doctor are used.

episodes.name: Ruben Søltoft wins hot dog competition
episodes.overview: Ruben Søltoft, Julie Ølgaard, Christian Fuhlendorff, Nikolaj Stokholm and Lina Rafn will build the best coconut throwing machine and paint a portrait on a canvas they cannot reach. A simple task with a ping-pong ball also costs several of the participants their dignity, and Mark Le Fêvre his eyesight, and then another obstacle forces Ruben Søltoft to visit a nursing home in North Jutland.

episodes.name: Camouflage yourself in a picture
episodes.overview: Can you cry out of your mouth? And how does Nikolaj Stokholm camouflage himself in a bathroom? Sure, the Grandmaster's challenges are crazy, but the solutions are even worse.

episodes.name: The grand finale
episodes.overview: It's time for the grand finale, and now it will be decided who can take grandmaster Lasse Rimmer's gilded head home as the season's overall winner. Julie Ølgaard, Nikolaj Stokholm, Ruben Søltoft, Lina Rafn and Christian Fuhlendorff are all ready to sacrifice both life and dignity in the pursuit of the Grandmaster's favour. They must both eat eggs on time, find their way with the help of a piece of toast bread and play mini golf with chicken eggs. And then we find out if there is a place on the body where Ruben Søltoft does not dare to put a pineapple in.

episodes.name: Sorry, Mark
episodes.overview: It's going to be a rough day at the office for Lasse Rimmer's faithful assistant Mark Le Fevre, when 5 crazy minds are asked to solve a particularly mean task.

episodes.name: The best cliffhanger
episodes.overview: Prepare yourself for 5 intense movies complete with cliffhangers about everything from bingo hungry cowboys to the secret behind spotting the perfect avocado and everything in between.

episodes.name: 50 different things
episodes.overview: What happens when 5 creative minds must create a ventriloquist's puppet, move sand, and catch tennis balls, but one of them gets a little too creative and must pay the prize.

episodes.name: Heino makes the Round Tower
episodes.overview: One of today's quirky tasks seriously messes with the contestants, and who ahs the most difficulties bulding a cardbox tower?

episodes.name: Kom I Døgnrapporten?
episodes.overview: Five creative minds are soaked, when taskmaster Lasse Rimmer dishes out new challenges, which indcludes everything from knock-knock jokes to quintaining.

episodes.name: Volcanoes in eruption
episodes.overview: It's time to battle for the remaining precious points before the final, and the 5 creative minds have their works cut out for them, as volcanoes are on the menu.

episodes.name: A sweaty finale
episodes.overview: Of course the taskmaster has saved the best for last. In the final the weary contenstants are given an unpleasant task which involves dialects and bodily fluids.

episodes.name: Can you bake the Taj Mahal?
All the way to the mind
Who the hell has a fax machine?
A genuine earhanger
episodes.overview: In this first episode of a new season, the fresh set of contestants must work out how many balls are in a basket, give Mark an unforgettable experience, drop a water balloon as far as possible without breaking it, create and perform a catchy song about something hanging in their ear, and pop up before a series of objects do.

episodes.name: Where are the aubergines?
episodes.overview: In this episode, the contestants must build a stork in the dark, hide three aubergines from Mark (and then guide him to them), do something impressive without their hands, pop a popcorn kernel, and sculpt the third most impressive dog.

episodes.name: Marianne Sunbull
episodes.overview: In this episode, the contestants must geta slice of bread into a toaster, make the most horrible sound, wear the most unexpected costume under their studio outfit, build the best beer mat house while ringing a doorbell, and strike poses to represent three things they have written on a board.

episodes.name: Who is the Swede?
episodes.overview: In this episode, the contestants must identify a person on a video call without being identified themselves, make the longest-lasting marble run, invent a new word (or ten), unravel a reel of string, and carry either an empty briefcase or a briefcase full of onions.

episodes.name: A new Simon
episodes.overview: In this episode, the contestants must complete 11 tasks with fruits and vegetables, do something uncharacteristic with 200 kroner, draw the biggest bike, subtly deliver a five word instruction to Mark, and name celebrities in time with some music.

episodes.name: The great disappearance number
episodes.overview: In this episode, the contestants must somehow get 11 non-human feet onto a mat, make the biggest thing disappear, find a needle in a haystack, make a realistic injury using food, and build the tallest tower of toilet rolls. Also, Martin's endurance for listening to repetitive saxophone music is pushed to its limits.

episodes.name: A spectacular finale
episodes.overview: In this season finale, the contestants must find out how much Mark's head and feet weigh, do a watchable parking job, build the lightest tower, set a puzzle to open a safe, solve the puzzle set by one of their opponents, and make a noise without being identified by the Taskmaster.

episodes.name: Cornflakes
episodes.overview: The anniversary season kicks off in a smell of onions, and it won’t be without tears as the five new contestants are welcomed into the Taskmaster’s wondrous world.

episodes.name: Fastest Loser
episodes.overview: Where is Mark, who’s his buddy, and what’s going on with all those hats? And why do the Taskmaster’s fortune cookies taste like paper?

episodes.name: The Black Owl
episodes.overview: Meet your salted friend, half a journalist, and a clog-carrying victim as five creative minds compete for the Taskmaster’s five points — and the losers get diddly-squat.

episodes.name: Driving License for Your Mother
episodes.overview: Five curly brains are ready to indulge your senses with everything from the loveliest almond milk to a loving greeting from Peter Werner’s mother.

episodes.name: The Fourth Way
episodes.overview: Lisbeth digs into the big costume trunk, and Rasmus shows a vulnerable side. We also find out why Jacob Riising has a problem with Sebastian Klein.

episodes.name: Groin Juice
episodes.overview: Take a deep breath and get ready to meet the slap-worthy robot that serves everything from Italian pasta dishes to freshly squeezed groin juice.

episodes.name: The Smell of Shame
episodes.overview: Both crap and layer cake are served to the five good-natured contestants, who also learn what five points actually smell like.

episodes.name: Rock, Paper, Scissors, Fuck
episodes.overview: Everything’s at stake in the season finale, where both high-fives and bruises are handed out. Lisbeth also regrets inviting her mother along.
